title: A loop that earns its next turn.
subtitle: Create → Capture → Verify → Transfer → Operate → Learn → a stronger next venture.
socialSubtitle: Create → Capture → Verify → Transfer → Operate → Learn → the next venture.
socialDetail: Only measured improvement makes the loop count.
detail: The loop counts only when a capability crosses a venture boundary and improves a measured outcome against a baseline.
diagramAlt: Create, Capture, Verify, Transfer, Operate, and Learn lead back to a stronger starting point for the next independent venture. A measured improvement is required before the loop counts.
